QuestInfo.name: Superior Implements
QuestInfo.1: Jay's weapon broke in the last battle. Defeat certain Cygnus Knights that carry #b#t4032925##k to get Jay a replacement.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Jay the wands he needed for his research.

0.0: Ah, hello. Thank you so much for bringing peace back to our town. I was starting to doubt we'd ever be free.

yes.1: Apparently certain Cygnus Knights carry powerful weapons, #b#t4032925##k. I'd like one of those, if you don't mind.

no.0: I'm eternally grateful for all you've done, but I was wondering if you might help me get a new weapon.

0.1: Well, I say that, but the job's not over yet. We still have the arduous task of getting rid of the remaining Cygnus Knights.
0.2: However, my weapon broke in the last battle.

yes.0: With this, we should have no trouble getting rid of the Cygnus Knights now. Thank you again for all you've done. I don't know how to repay you.
